subject: [PATCH 09/11] nfsd: grant a plain read delegation when timestamps are wanted on a read open

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFS server to grant a plain read delegation when a client requests delegated timestamps on a read open, rather than attempting to delegate atime attributes which would require exclusive authority or merging of times from multiple clients. The want flag for attribute delegation is considered only a request and can be declined without violating RFC 9754 section 5. This change simplifies the handling of delegations and avoids potential issues with concurrent access to file metadata.
